All visible text lives here. Edit values, not keys. Every entry has English (en) and Chinese (zh). Simple HTML allowed:
= line break, & = &. Don't rename keys or break the JSON. After editing, save and redeploy.

metaDescription.en: Josephine Shen — research and strategy at the meeting point of AI, security, and the state.
metaDescription.zh: 沈约瑟芬——研究与战略，立于人工智能、安全与国家的交汇之处。

hero.en: Building the connective tissue between AI policy, security, and the state — from the grassroots up to governance.
hero.zh: 构建人工智能政策、安全与国家之间的连接组织——从基层一路通向治理。

hero_sub.en: Research, facilitation and strategy for the institutions, communities and companies shaping how advanced AI meets the public good.
hero_sub.zh: 为塑造先进人工智能如何服务公共利益的机构、社区与企业，提供研究、协调与战略支持。

about_p1.en: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua. Ut enim ad minim veniam, quis nostrud exercitation ullamco laboris nisi ut aliquip ex ea commodo consequat.
about_p1.zh: 占位文本。此处将替换为该领域工作的真实摘录，用以呈现其政策与研究写作的风格、结构与论证方式，供读者参考与评估。

about_p2.en: Embedded across the seams between sectors, the work facilitates the emergence of new systems for AI, security and society — translating between the people who build capability, the bodies that govern it, and the communities who live with its consequences.
about_p2.zh: 在各部门的接缝之间展开工作，促成人工智能、安全与社会新系统的形成——在构建能力的人、治理能力的机构，以及承受其后果的社区之间进行转译。

areas_intro.en: The practice spans the places where AI and statecraft meet, and where careful work can lead to lasting infrastructural change.
areas_intro.zh: 实践横跨人工智能与治国之术相遇之处，以及审慎的工作能够带来持久制度性变革之处。

fig_caption.en: Three registers of the work — State, Industry, Grassroots — each resolving into the concrete capabilities the practice operates across. Select a layer.
fig_caption.zh: 工作的三个层面——国家、产业、基层——各自展开为实践所贯穿的具体能力。点击任一层级。

contact_blurb.en: For collaborations, briefings, convenings, or correspondence.
contact_blurb.zh: 合作、简报、召集或来函，欢迎联系。

roles_list.en: Researcher / Facilitator / Strategist / Libertine / Provocateur / Arsonist
roles_list.zh: 研究者 / 促进者 / 战略家 / 风流者 / 煽动者 / 纵火者

en.title: Regulatory Design
en.body: Working on the rules, mandates and levers of compliance that decide what advanced systems are allowed to do.

en.title: Institutional Strategy
en.body: Reading how agencies, bodies and standards organisations actually move — and where the leverage really sits.

en.title: Field-Building
en.body: Convening the right people and growing the talent the work requires, from grassroots up to governance.

en.title: Public-Interest AI
en.body: Keeping the public in public policy: measurement, deployment and safety oriented to the common good.

zh.title: 监管设计
zh.body: 围绕规则、授权与合规杠杆展开工作，决定先进系统被允许做什么。

zh.title: 制度战略
zh.body: 解读各机构、组织与标准制定者如何真正行动——以及真正的杠杆所在。

zh.title: 领域建设
zh.body: 召集合适的人、培养工作所需的人才，从基层一路通向治理。

zh.title: 公共利益人工智能
zh.body: 让公共政策守住公共：以共同利益为导向的测量、部署与安全。
